🎥🎬: Young Justice (2010–2022)

A group of teenage heroes—Robin, Superboy, Kid Flash, Aqualad, Miss Martian, and Artemis—form a covert team after realizing they’re ready to prove themselves beyond the shadow of the Justice League. Taking on secret missions, they quickly discover that being a hero comes with consequences far beyond fighting villains.

As the team grows, their missions lead them into a much larger conspiracy involving the mysterious Light, alien invasions, metahuman trafficking, and threats to Earth itself. Friendships are tested, heroes are lost, and the young team must mature quickly as they fight to protect a world that doesn’t always know they’re there.
